sample_unit: surgically confirmed hip fracture AP pelvis radiographs

links.outcome: Model performance when prompts contained incorrect laterality cues versus correct cues
links.effect: Incorrect laterality cues degraded performance from 90.7% to 66.4% in GPT-5.4 and from 97.7% to 57.0% in Gemini.
links.quote: Incorrect laterality cues markedly degraded performance, from 90.7% to 66.4% in GPT-5.4 and from 97.7% to 57.0% in Gemini.

links.outcome: Whether self-reported confidence distinguished correct from incorrect outputs
links.effect: Both models frequently remained highly confident when wrong; self-reported confidence did not reliably distinguish correct from incorrect outputs.
links.quote: Both models frequently remained highly confident when wrong, and self-reported confidence did not reliably distinguish correct from incorrect outputs.

unlisted_practices: Combining outputs from two general-purpose multimodal models to exploit complementary error patterns

screen.reason: Empirical study testing general-purpose multimodal LLMs on pelvic radiograph interpretation across different prompt conditions, assessing vulnerability to misleading cues and overconfidence, but does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
